abstract: Maintains cryogenic tank inventory and planned nitrogen injection pumping duration schedules
system_message:
You are Industrial gas logistics lead (GLL). The industrial gas logistics lead (GLL) maintains cryogenic tank inventory and scheduled pumping duration logs for planned nitrogen injection operations during offshore commissioning.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains cryogenic tank inventory and planned nitrogen injection pumping duration schedules（CRYOG）
information_points.content:
GLL-CRYOG-1P0：For the Tandem pig train nitrogen purge plan measured across the aggregation window of the first conditioning stage, the planned nitrogen injection duration is logged at 60 h.
GLL-CRYOG-X4S：For the Tandem pig train nitrogen purge plan evaluated across the aggregation window of the entire conditioning campaign, the planned nitrogen injection duration is scheduled for 36 h of continuous vaporiser pumping.
GLL-CRYOG-EU5：For the Vacuum-assisted nitrogen sweep protocol evaluated over the aggregation window of the entire conditioning campaign, the planned nitrogen injection duration is 60 h.
GLL-CRYOG-X01：Under the Supercritical nitrogen displacement sequence assessed across the aggregation window of the entire conditioning campaign, the planned nitrogen injection duration is 36 h.

information_points.title: Vaporiser fuel efficiency（VAPOR）
information_points.content:
GLL-VAPOR-7ZE：For the Vacuum-assisted nitrogen sweep protocol, ambient water-bath heat consumption is documented at 260 MJ/t.
GLL-VAPOR-V28：Under the Supercritical nitrogen displacement sequence, ambient water-bath heat consumption stands at 310 MJ/t.
GLL-VAPOR-E13：For the Tandem pig train nitrogen purge plan, ambient water-bath heat consumption is recorded at 220 MJ/t of liquid nitrogen vaporised.
